method: read-only byte comparison against the frozen BBIN and retained Ghidra -readOnly -noanalysis exports

dispatch_table.note: String table indices 4/5 are K10/K05 while the threshold rows are 0x0A05/0x0A10 (K05/K10); the two are swapped.

secondary_tables.channel_map_role: 8-byte index remap consumed through config-object slot +0x1a4 (u32 index 0x69); main dispatcher 0801e674 reads the pointer and copies 8 bytes into the report object when non-NULL.

baud_divisor_table.role: u16 divisor indexed by config[9]; config[9] also occupies the low nibble of the peripheral +0x2c register

writers: 0x0800f74c: strb r1(=1),[0x2000a4c0 + 0x18c = 0x2000a64c], followed by DSB #0xf / DMB #0x1f / SEV (different base object)
readers: 0x0801e68a (main dispatcher 0801d888): ldrb r1,[r7 + 0x18c] with r7 = param_1
plus_0x18c.downstream: copied to report object param_2 + 0x3a80 at 0801e692; the adjacent byte +0x18d goes to +0x3a81; 0xff is a sentinel that redirects through 0801ea3e
plus_0x18c.disambiguation: 0xc6 << 2 = 0x318 (0800c6f4) and 0xc6 << 5 = 0x18c0 (080153c6) are DIFFERENT slots, not this byte; only the three lsls #1 sites build 0x18c

plus_0x1a0.reader: 0x0801e666: ldr r1,[r7 + 0x1a0]; if non-NULL, 8 bytes are copied via 08020f94

plus_0x1a4.reader: 0x0801e678: ldr r1,[r7 + 0x1a4]; if non-NULL, 8 bytes are copied via 08020f94 at 0801e680
plus_0x1a4.accumulation: the 14 dispatch rows are applied cumulatively (all rows whose threshold <= hwrev), so later setters overwrite this slot; 08011100 runs later as a callback

usart_brr.division_helper: 0x08008174 = unsigned integer division param_1 / param_2; quotient in r0, remainder in r1

config_object.param_1[1]: target baud rate (runtime value; no compile-time baud constant exists in the image)
config_object.param_1[9]: u16 index into 0x0802420c; also written to the low nibble of peripheral +0x2c

clock_sources: FUN_0800cd24() runtime SYSCLK at call sites 0x0800e9ba and 0x0800ea20 (64MHz per the previous PLL round, conditional)

path_B.label: 8x oversampling, x2 and 3-bit fraction
path_B.formula: q = clock // table[config[9]]; N = (2*q + (baud >> 1)) // baud; BRR = (N & 0xfff0) | ((N & 0xf) >> 1)

usart_brr.range_check: 0x0800e98a/0x0800e9fa: (BRR - 0x10) must be <= 0xffef, i.e. 0x10 <= BRR <= 0xffff; otherwise 0800e950 returns 1 (error)
usart_brr.source_select: RCC 0x40021054 bits [1:0]/[3:2]/[5:4] choose the USART clock source; the branches at 0800e900..0800e9d8 pick path A, path B, the 16MHz fallback or the runtime SYSCLK

limits: The channel maps are byte permutations; which physical sensor channel each index denotes needs a schematic or device.
0x2000a4c0 + 0x18c and param_1 + 0x18c share the same offset but have different base objects; static bytes do not prove they are the same field.
param_1[1] (baud) and param_1[9] (divisor index) are runtime values; no standard baud-rate constant appears anywhere in the 132896-byte image.
0x0800cd24() = 64MHz is a conditional computed value from the previous round, not a measured oscillator.
RCC 0x40021054 is a live register; which clock-source branch runs on hardware cannot be fixed statically.
No firmware executed; no device, account, API or network access.
